method: Built-in image generation; wheat raster binarized and traced with potrace, mechanically tinted white for in-scene gold print. WebP exports resized/compressed with the existing sharp dependency. No hand-authored vector paths.

artwork.brief: Retro enamel-sign illustration, friendly sage green collapsed dinosaur, curled tail, bold X eye, cream belly and coral tongue; transparent; no lettering.
Three heritage wheat ears with alternating almond kernels, bowed side stalks and tied ribbon; black on white, then traced to white alpha mask for gold printing.

artwork.brief: The MillOS application mark: turquoise waterwheel forming an M, gold grain kernel, two turquoise water waves, on #081015. Used as the favicon.
